scope: Consumed-data follow-up to post-hoc displaced peaks; no fits or accuracy changes
groups: Full cohort and chronological halves split at median paired time; additionally each exact RF and its same halves. Diagnostic strata, not validation splits.
histogram: 500 Hz bins from -113750 through 114250; mode by count; ties lowest signed bin. Fixed bins inherited from iteration34.
limitations: Modes can reflect different identities; selected maximum is biased and null counts at selected bins are descriptive only.
